<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template for a Friedel‑Crafts acylation, I will search the template catalog for reactions that form a new C–C bond between two sp2 carbons (bond type “6‑6”) while breaking an aromatic C–Cl bond (bond type “6‑8”) and the original C–C bond of the acyl chloride (also “6‑6”). This should retrieve templates that correspond to the forward Friedel‑Crafts acylation, which can then be used retrosynthetically to generate the aryl halide and acyl chloride precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccccc1C(=O)C", 
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
